visual.where: b001-b100, library-library4, m01-m12, quotes (top right, under the trail)

visual.issue: Setup check promises buttons that 'jump and return', but there is no way back to the page from the targets except Home then Setup check (two taps). The page explains this, but it is not the one-tap return the brief describes.

Start here step 4 tells Oct-Dec buyers to 'begin a fresh copy in January'. That suggests restarting the 100-book Library each year and goes against the undated 'nothing is wasted' pitch. It also does not say how to get a fresh copy (re-download or duplicate in the app).
The Setup check eyebrow repeats the title ('Setup check' above 'Setup check'); every other page uses a different eyebrow (Five minutes, Up next, Goal).
Start here step 1 is 'Open it in a note app', but its Go there button opens Contents, and the text has to say 'This button opens Contents'. The button does not match its step.
The 'top bar, on every page' legend lists only Library, TBR and Quotes, leaving one cell of the 2x2 grid empty. Home is missing, although the Setup check legend includes it.
The swash descender on 'J' in January and July sits left of the page's text margin, so the month title looks misaligned against the eyebrow and cards.
Month pages show the year blank as typed underscores ('Month · year ____'), while the Reading year page uses a ruled line. The two fill-in styles are inconsistent and the underscores look unfinished.
The brass detail appears on the cover, Contents and Start here but not on Setup check, the other guide page named in the look brief.
The Reading year format tallies have only Print, Ebook and Audio, but the book page lets readers write in another format, so a write-in format has nowhere to be tallied.
Photo 5 crops Start here to steps 1-2 only, which leaves the lower-left quarter of the photo empty next to the full-height Setup check panel.
The hero bullet 'Goodnotes, Notability and Android' mixes two apps with a platform and leaves out iPad, the main device.
The listing says 2.88 MB, but the file is 2,889,786 bytes (2.89 MB decimal, 2.76 MiB). This is a small mismatch with the built file (r003).
